description: Reads a coded message back to text in angka, koordinat, Merah Putih, Polybius, AZ (Atbash), AN (ROT13), kimia, jam, AND, Napoleon or ular. Kotak, rumput and semaphore are drawings and have no text reader. Returns the decoded text, the key used and a link to the SandiMorse page with the same input.

hour.description: Hour of the letter A in jam, 0 to 23. Default 8.

language.description: Language of the answer and of the page the link opens: id for Indonesian or en for English. Default id.

left_word.description: Row key word of koordinat: 5 different letters A to Z.

minute.description: Minute of the letter A in jam, 0 to 59. Default 0.

reading.description: Reading order of ular: snake reads rows back and forth, column reads top to bottom. Default snake.

start.description: Number for the letter A in angka. Default 1.

step.description: Step between letters: a number for angka (default 1) or minutes for jam (default 5).

text.description: The coded message, for example numbers for angka, letter pairs for koordinat, times for jam or a formula for kimia.

top_word.description: Column key word of koordinat: 5 different letters A to Z. Both key words are needed for a custom key.

width.description: Letters per row in napoleon (default 6) or ular (default 4), 2 to 30.

name: decode_scout_code
title: Decode a scout code
